Job Position: Accounting / Administrative Officer

Job Location: Ogudu, Ori-Oke - Lagos

Overview


	This job is a blend of accounting, administrative and general services functions.


Key Responsibilities


	Keep/track records of all financial transactions - including account receivables and account payables.
	Reconcile bank transfers (inflows/outflows) with internal accounting records/receipt books.
	Facilitate/drive the preparation of periodic operational budgets &amp; implementation.
	Process invoices/bills for purchases/services rendered for approval &amp; payments.
	Manage school fees billing system, track payments, reconciliations and prepare periodic payment status reports.
	Monitor income/expenditure in line with the budget and produce monthly financial reports.
	Provide general administrative support in accordance with Management instructions.
	Ensure good functionality of various office equipment/facilities &amp; ensure preventive maintenance.
	Perform all other duties that may be assigned to you by Management from time to time.


Requirements


	BSc / HND in Accounting / Business Administration.
	Minimum of 2 years of post graduation accounting experience.
	Previous work experience in a reputable school will be an added advantage.
	Strong attention to details and good analytical skill.
	Excellent IT capability, with advanced MS Excel skill.
	A strong business orientation.
	Excellent communication.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs to: kingstonbridgeschool@gmail.com using the Job Position (Accounting/ Admin Officer) as the subject of the email.

Accounting / Administrative Officer Job at  Kingston Bridge School (KBS)




        
    

        
        The Kingston Bridge School (KBS) is a "Grade A" Nursery and Primary School, strategically located within Ogudu Ori-Oke Lagos. Our vision is to be the foremost caring school in Nigeria, inspiring excellence and fostering success.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Accounting / Administrative Officer

Job Location: Ogudu, Ori-Oke - Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Overview


	This job is a blend of accounting, administrative and general services functions.


Key Responsibilities
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Keep/track records of all financial transactions - including account receivables and account payables.
	Reconcile bank transfers (inflows/outflows) with internal accounting records/receipt books.
	Facilitate/drive the preparation of periodic operational budgets & implementation.
	Process invoices/bills for purchases/services rendered for approval & payments.
	Manage school fees billing system, track payments, reconciliations and prepare periodic payment status reports.
	Monitor income/expenditure in line with the budget and produce monthly financial reports.
	Provide general administrative support in accordance with Management instructions.
	Ensure good functionality of various office equipment/facilities & ensure preventive maintenance.
	Perform all other duties that may be assigned to you by Management from time to time.


Requirements


	BSc / HND in Accounting / Business Administration.
	Minimum of 2 years of post graduation accounting experience.
	Previous work experience in a reputable school will be an added advantage.
	Strong attention to details and good analytical skill.
	Excellent IT capability, with advanced MS Excel skill.
	A strong business orientation.
	Excellent communication.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs to: [email protected] using the Job Position (Accounting/ Admin Officer) as the subject of the email.

Note: Qualified applicants who reside around Ogudu, Ojota, Alapere, Ketu, Ikosi and Oworonshoki environments will have added advantage.

Senior Accountant Job at Ginos Ventures Limited




        
    

        
        Ginos Ventures Limited - As an Indigenous distributor of medical consumables and devices across Africa, we provide solutions to all problems of procurement, distribution, and supply of all medical consumables.

We currently distribute for over 15 multinational healthcare companies and have a working relationship with about 60% of healthcare institutions in Nigeria with 23 Medical Representatives and 10 mini distributors that cover major regions in the country.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Senior Accountant
Job Location: Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time

The Role
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	As our Senior Accountant, you will be responsible for overseeing key accounting and financial operations, maintaining financial accuracy, strengthening internal controls, and providing valuable financial insights to support the growth and strategic objectives of the Company.


Key Responsibilties


	Prepare and maintain accurate financial records and reports.
	Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
	Monitor and reconcile bank statements, ledgers, and accounts.
	Oversee Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable processes.
	Ensure compliance with statutory requirements, tax regulations, and Company policies.
	Handle payroll processing and monitor financial transactions.
	Conduct financial analysis and provide actionable insights and recommendations.
	Coordinate internal and external audit processes.
	Monitor budgets and cash flow activities.
	Supervise and support accounting staff where applicable.
	Ensure timely filing of taxes and statutory deductions.
	Implement and continuously improve accounting systems, processes, and financial controls.


What We Are Looking For
We are looking for someone who is:


	Qualified: Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
	Experienced: 5–7 years of relevant accounting experience, preferably in a senior accounting role.
	Professionally grounded: ACA, ACCA, ICAN, or equivalent certification is an added advantage.
	Technically sound: Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, and tax regulations.
	Tech-savvy: Proficient in accounting software and Microsoft Excel.
	Analytical: Strong problem-solving, analytical, and organizational abilities.
	A great communicator: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	Trustworthy: Demonstrates a high level of integrity, accuracy, and attention to detail.
	Mobile: Ability to drive is an added advantage.
	Available: Must be resident in Abuja.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV/Resume and Cover Letter to:[email protected] using "Senior Accountant – Abuja" as the subject of the email.

  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Projects - Start-Up Specialist II",
  "description": "ABNL Limited was incorporated in 1992 as an Oil and Gas servicing company with a vision to provide professional engineering and technical services to the Oil and Gas exploration and production companies in Nigeria and the West African sub-region. Since its incorporation, the company has grown in leaps and bounds, expanding its business horizon, but still within the Oil and Gas sector.

ABNL is a 100% owned indigenous firm, with a shareholding in excess of 100 million Naira. Its&#39; directors are individuals of proven integrity, who over the years have acquired the requisite experience in the Oil and Gas business, as well as in the banking and finance sector. The integrity of the directors and the staff of the company have been a priceless contributive factor in the growth and wellbeing of the company.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Projects - Start-Up Specialist II

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Contract

Main Functions


	Start-Up Discipline Specialist (Rotating Machinery, Electrical, Process, Document Control Services (DCS), Instrument) focus on field execution of the start-up activities. The role is characterized by:
	Strong technical skills within the specified discipline (e.g., Rotating Machinery, Electrical, Process, Instrumentation).
	Collaboration with the Project Team, Affiliate Operations, and Contractor to ensure requirements for start-up activities and continuous operations are clearly understood and adhered to.
	Detailed knowledge of operating facilities and applicable processes to put in place to manage risk
	Leadership to ensure project priorities of safety, quality, and schedule are achieved.

	Start-Up Discipline Specialist (Rotating Machinery, Electrical, Process, Document Control Services (DCS), Instrument) focus on field execution of the start-up activities. The role is characterized by:
	Strong technical skills within the specified discipline (e.g., Rotating Machinery, Electrical, Process, Instrumentation).
	Collaboration with the Project Team, Affiliate Operations, and Contractor to ensure requirements for start-up activities and continuous operations are clearly understood and adhered to.
	Detailed knowledge of operating facilities and applicable processes to put in place to manage risk
	Leadership to ensure project priorities of safety, quality, and schedule are achieved.

	Work with start-up coordinator & Start-up Manager to ensure that OE/IIF expectations are met.

	Development and execution of downstream start-up procedures to ensure a safe and efficient start-up of the project Integrated assets.

	Previous experience in a closely related position.
